goal: Make the merged CAREER_OS_RUN_CONTRACT_V1 executable against the live Production Ledger/SETTINGS shapes: hash actual runtime/font ZIPs, use live SETTINGS keys and live JOBS/APPLICATIONS/LOG schemas, dedupe from Ledger, bind packages to Ledger identity, and make closeout slate-authoritative and plan-complete.
acceptance_conditions: preflight uses the live SETTINGS keys and hashes the actual downloaded runtime ZIP and governed-fonts ZIP.
record-submit emits exactly the live 10-column APPLICATIONS shape, exact 9-column LOG shape, and only Job_ID/Application_Status for JOBS.
closeout extracts sha256:<64hex> from Resume_Version and never silently skips a required plan for a newly processed submitted role.
slate consumes a live-shape Ledger readback, marks Job_ID/Official_URL duplicates ALREADY_TRACKED, and emits no duplicate JOBS row.
package consumes a live-shape Ledger readback and requires exact Job_ID/Company/Role/Official_URL identity; blank Official_URL fails closed.
closeout consumes the slate receipt rather than a hand-authored batch list.
A live-shape end-to-end fixture preflight->slate->package->verify-persisted->record-submit->closeout reaches COMPLETE.
Runbook contains exact command lines, minimal input examples, and forbids Google Docs conversion for persisted artifacts.
review_requirements: STOP after one PR is opened. Do not merge until Bora obtains a fresh independent read-only SAFE review.
stop_conditions: Any need to change the #122 resume QA gates, matcher, qualification, pursuit, Candidate Truth, approved resume language, renderer, cloud adapter, or external submission semantics.
Any request to write Drive/Sheets/application state from this engineering PR.
Any need for UI, database, service, scraper, scoring, cover-letter runtime, auto-submit, or automatic bullet selection.
human_approval_requirements: Bora retains all consequential decisions, all Ledger/Drive writes, all application submission authority, merge authority, and the OpalAI/Liberty's Promise decisions.
